title: Two-member planar joint equilibrium
prompt: Implement solve(payload) for a planar pin joint connected to two ideal axial members. angles_deg contains their two directions, measured counterclockwise from +x, away from the joint; load_n is the external [Fx,Fy] load in newtons. Find member forces F1,F2 satisfying F1*[cos(a),sin(a)]+F2*[cos(b),sin(b)]+load=0. Return {"forces_n":[F1,F2]} in angle order. Positive force means tension; negative means compression. Convert degrees to radians, including negative and unwrapped angles. If abs(cos(a)*sin(b)-sin(a)*cos(b)) <= 1e-10, return {"error":"singular_directions"}. Inputs contain exactly two valid finite angles and load components; other validation is outside this task. Do not mutate inputs. Absolute/relative tolerance 1e-7.
